units.source_text: 雪光的反射令人眩目，黑暗的车厢里什么也没有看见。

en.t: The reflection of the snowlight was dazzling, and nothing could be seen inside the dark carriage.

units.source_text: 只见车篷的采亮光线中，仿佛有个白色的东西在动。

en.t: Only in the bright light filtering through the carriage canopy did it seem that something white was moving.
It looked as though a rabbit was moving.
